A few useful details

Before you begin.

What can I do in V1?

Create and organise projects, attach files, write structured prompts, connect a model, and save responses. Explore the two built-in brand projects and their seven design directions in the design studio.

Does Vibe automatically build or publish my website?

V1 helps you prepare, generate and review work. Model responses and exported design notes are available for implementation; automatic code execution and website publishing are not part of this version.

Where does my work live?

Projects, briefs, files and run history are stored by this local workspace server. A model request sends the prompt and selected attachments to the provider you connect. Your entered API key is kept in server memory for the session.

Which models can I use?

Use your OpenAI connection, or configure a compatible endpoint in Connections. Model access, provider capabilities and usage charges depend on your provider account.
